status.notReady: Not ready — finish environment setup to start

setup.title: Set up your environment
setup.intro: Gen Asset Studio needs Codex CLI and a ChatGPT account to generate images. Finish the steps below before you start — the app installs everything; you only sign in and grant permission when asked.

perm.title: Check permissions
perm.desc: Checks whether the app runs as Administrator.

codex.title: Install Codex CLI
codex.desc: Downloads the pinned Codex CLI into the app folder and verifies the checksum. No Node, Python or ffmpeg needed.

path.title: Add to PATH
path.desc: Adds Codex to the user PATH. No admin rights needed.

longPath.title: Enable long paths
longPath.desc: Allows paths longer than 260 characters for deep asset folders. Needs Administrator.

login.title: Sign in to Codex
login.desc: Sign in to Codex with your ChatGPT account.

quota.title: Check quota + test generation
quota.desc: Reads your quota and generates one small test image to confirm image generation works.

workspace.title: Choose a workspace
workspace.desc: Create a new workspace or open an existing folder. Each subfolder groups projects.

perm.admin: Running as Administrator — steps that need it run automatically.
perm.user: Running as a standard user — you will be asked when a step needs admin rights.

codex.checking: Looking for an installed Codex CLI…

path.ask: Add Codex to your user PATH to run codex from a terminal. The app does not need this — you can skip it.
path.skipped: Skipped — the app still uses its own Codex path.

longPath.needAdmin: Long paths are off. Enabling them needs Administrator rights.
longPath.waitingUac: Waiting for you to confirm UAC…
longPath.skipped: Skipped — paths longer than 260 characters may fail on export.

login.signedOut: Not signed in. Sign in to Codex with a ChatGPT Plus (or higher) account — the Free plan cannot generate images.
login.waiting: Waiting for the browser — come back once you have signed in.
login.signedInFree: {{email}} · Free — the Free plan CANNOT generate images. Switch to a ChatGPT Plus (or higher) account before generating.

workspace.choose: Create a new workspace or open an existing folder. Each subfolder groups projects.

testGen.hint: Optional — uses a little quota. You can skip it.

workspace.newDesc: Pick or create an empty folder
workspace.openDesc: Pick a folder used as a workspace

uac.title: Administrator rights needed
uac.body: The “Enable long paths” step changes a system registry key (LongPathsEnabled). Windows will show a UAC prompt to confirm.
uac.tip: Run the app with “Run as administrator” to skip these confirmations.

workspace.title: All projects
workspace.subtitle: No projects in this workspace yet
workspace.emptyDesc: Create a project to import an image set (PNG preferred), lock a style, then regenerate it with Codex.
workspace.folderEmptyTitle: This folder has no projects yet
workspace.folderEmptyDesc: Create a project to start reskinning an asset set.
workspace.noWsDesc: Choose a folder to use as the workspace for your projects.
workspace.wsMissingDesc: The folder {{path}} was deleted or renamed. Choose the workspace again.

gen.parallelHint: Shared by the whole queue, applies immediately
gen.scaleHint: ×2/×4 is a plain resize, no regeneration

taskHint.promptPolish: rewrites prompts and notes into English
taskHint.styleSuggest: analyzes the set, draws preview sheets

gen.modelsNote: Default: luna · medium for all three. Higher effort is slower and uses more quota.

closeBusy.label: Closing while generating
closeBusy.hint: Closing with tasks running minimizes to the taskbar and keeps working; closing again asks whether to quit.

update.warn: A newer version may not be compatible with the app yet. The current version is kept so you can go back.

account.notSignedInDesc: Sign in with a ChatGPT Plus (or higher) account to generate images.
account.waiting: Waiting for sign-in in your browser…

fix.title: Ask Codex to fix this
fix.analyzing: Codex is reading the log and finding the cause…
fix.applied: Codex applied the fix. Press Try again to re-run the step.
fix.tip: Codex only changes the app folder and the app’s Codex config. System changes ask for permission separately. If Codex CLI itself is not installed, only Retry and Export log are available.
fix.unavailable: Codex CLI is not installed or not signed in — only Retry and Export log are available.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Project name
newProject.hint: A project is a folder with a project.json inside the workspace. Source images are not copied — the project only stores their paths.

trash.title: Move “{{name}}” to the Recycle Bin?
trash.folderBody: The folder and everything in it ({{count}} projects) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. You can restore it from there.
trash.projectBody: The project folder (styles, versions, output) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. Source images outside it are not touched.

errors.invalidName: Invalid name — avoid < > : " / \ | ? * and a trailing dot.
errors.exists: An item with that name already exists there.
errors.notFound: Item not found — it may have been renamed or deleted.
errors.intoSelf: Cannot move an item into itself or into a project.
errors.busy: The file is in use by another program. Close it and try again.

toast.dup: {{count}} images are already in the project

lock.style: Add at least one image first

lock.export: Approve at least one image before exporting

soon.title: Coming soon

input.footer: {{count}} images · up to 100 per run · Ctrl/Shift or drag to multi-select
input.overLimit: This project has {{count}} images — each generation run takes up to 100, so the Generate step will split it into several runs.

polish.loading: Codex is checking and rewriting the prompt…
polish.title: Suggested prompt (English)

refs.label: Reference images

tpl.title: Style templates
tpl.desc: quick start — fills the group prompt, still editable
tpl.saveDesc: Save this group’s prompt and style lock image as a template for other projects.
tpl.name: Template name

sugg.title: Style directions
sugg.promptOnlyHint: No extra directions — draw one preview straight from the group prompt
sugg.empty: Codex looks at your images, prompt and references, then proposes {{count}} style directions, each with a preview sheet redrawing a few representative assets (sent as individual images).
sugg.planning: Codex is analyzing the set and planning directions…
sugg.emptyShort: Codex looks at your assets + description and proposes {{count}} directions, each with a preview.

fb.label: Feedback for Codex
fb.placeholder: e.g. bolder, drop the yellow rim, rounder buttons

style.lockDesc: The preview becomes the style lock image attached to every generation in this group.

pick.title: Pick a style
pick.desc: click a card — AI suggestion or built-in template
pick.noneDesc: Create a style in ② (Your own · Templates · AI suggestions), select a card, then lock it to move on to Gen.

src.desc: pick one of three ways to create a style

custom.name: Your own
custom.desc: from your description and/or reference images

ai.name: AI suggestions
ai.desc: Codex proposes a few directions to compare
ai.note: AI looks at the group’s assets plus your description and reference images (Your own tab), then proposes different directions.

custom.need: Write a description or add at least one reference image to draw a preview.
custom.ready: Draw one preview first (≈ 1 generation), or lock the description right away to go straight to Gen.
custom.noPreview: No preview yet — you can lock the description right away

custom.lockedDesc: Locked from description + reference images (no style lock image) — every generation in this group uses it.

gen.title: Generate images
gen.desc: Each image goes to Codex with its source and the group style lock, then the background is removed, it is fit to the source W×H and QA runs.
gen.parallelHint: images at once · shared across the queue
gen.modelNote: change model + effort in Settings → Generation
gen.outOfQuotaDesc: Pauses, counts down and resumes automatically when quota resets.
gen.notLocked: Group “{{name}}” has no locked style — its images will not be generated.
gen.ungrouped: {{count}} images are in no group — not generated, not exported.

queue.title: Generation queue
queue.empty: No project is generating right now.
queue.quotaDesc: Finished images are kept. The run resumes automatically when quota resets — you can leave it overnight.
queue.pausedDesc: Nothing is sent to Codex until you resume.
queue.noImageTitle: Queue stopped: Codex returned no image
queue.noImageDesc: Several images in a row finished without an image. This usually means the ChatGPT Free plan cannot generate images — switch to a Plus (or higher) account, then resume.

review.emptyAllDesc: Generate images in step 3, then come back to review them.

proc.title: Processing
proc.nineHint: Keep the 4 corners, stretch the middle to fill the source box
proc.edgesHint: Sides allowed to touch the canvas edge (e.g. a back button glued to the left)
proc.hint: Re-runs background removal + fit + QA on the raw AI image of v{{v}}. No regeneration, no quota, creates a new version.
proc.noRaw: Raw AI image of this version is missing

regen.title: Regenerate with new notes
regen.placeholder: e.g. thicker outline, keep the OK text, less gloss
regen.noGroup: This image is not in a locked style group
regen.hint: The note is appended to the group prompt; generates from the source into a new version.

export.desc: Only approved images are exported. Source folders are never written to.
export.descAll: Exports the selected version of every image that has one (approved or not). Source folders are never written to.
export.formatVal: Keeps the original format (PNG recommended) · keeps alpha and file names
export.treeEmpty: No image is ready to export yet

err.outInsideSource: The destination is inside a source folder — pick another one
err.outIsFile: The destination path is a file, not a folder

done.title: Exported {{count}} images
done.backup: {{count}} existing files were backed up to

tree.title: Folder tree
tree.body: Each folder is a real directory in your workspace. Drag to reorganise; right-click or use “…” to rename or delete.

sample.title: Sample project
sample.body: The sample project ships with a UI image set so you can try the whole flow: source → style → generate → review → export.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.body: Create a project in the selected folder. Each project is one asset set to reskin.

queue.title: Shared queue
queue.body: All projects share one queue. It pauses when quota runs out and resumes when it resets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Theme, language, parallel jobs, your Codex account and a button to replay this guide live here.

steps.title: Five steps
steps.body: Work left to right. Steps that are not ready are locked; hover to see why.

input.title: Add source images
input.body: Drop images (PNG preferred) or whole folders here. The folder structure is kept on export.

style.title: Style groups
style.body: Group images, pick a template or ask for style suggestions, then lock the style before generating.

gen.title: Batch generate
gen.body: Press Start to queue the whole group. You can switch to another project while it runs.

review.title: Review results
review.body: Compare source and result, pick a version, approve or regenerate each image.

export.title: Export
export.body: Export with the same names, exact sizes and the original folder tree. Optional x2/x4 copies.

groups.title: Style groups
groups.body: Each group has its own style. The sample project already has one group filled from the Candy Pop template.

templates.title: Built-in templates
templates.body: Pick a template to fill the prompt and palette, or let AI suggest a few style directions.

lock.title: Lock the style
lock.body: Locking fixes the style sample image. Only locked groups can be generated.

kinds.label: Asset type
kinds.soonToast: {{name}} is coming soon — still images are supported for now (PNG preferred).

png.name: 2D images
png.desc: PNG (recommended), JPG, WebP… — UI, icons, buttons, panels

input.what: Add the original images you want to restyle — drag in a folder or files. PNG is preferred (keeps transparency); JPG/WebP/AVIF/TIFF also work. Turn on 9-slice for stretchable buttons/frames.

style.what: Choose the group’s assets, then create a style one of three ways: Your own (description / reference images), Templates, or AI suggestions. Select a card and Lock — the locked style is the reference for redrawing the whole set.

gen.what: Press “Generate” and Codex redraws each asset in the locked style. Runs in the background — review finished images as they come.

review.what: Compare original and new. Approve (A) if good, Needs fix (X) or regenerate (R) with a note otherwise. Only approved assets are exported.

export.what: Pick an output folder and scale ×1/×2/×4. Approved assets are exported with the same file names + folder tree; old files are backed up.
